title: Communications
subtitle: Public record of the Institute's newsletters, weekly announcements, and periodic reports.
audience: Members, participants, collaborators, and the public who want a record of the Institute's public communications.
lede: As a participatory, open-science 501(c)(3) nonprofit, the Institute publishes a recurring newsletter, weekly announcements, and periodic reports as part of its regular work. This page lists the current public record of those communications.

sections.heading: Newsletter
sections.body: The Active Inference Institute — March 2026 Newsletter (reference AII-NL-2026-03), dated March 1, 2026, is the current issue in the monthly newsletter series.

sections.heading: Weekly Announcements
sections.body: Active Inference Institute — Weekly Update #10 (reference AII-WA-2026-W10), dated March 4, 2026, is the current issue in the weekly announcement series.

sections.heading: Annual Reports
sections.body: The 2025 Annual Review (reference AII-AR-2025, dated January 15, 2026) covers the Institute's 2025 year. The 2026 Annual Preview & Strategic Plan (reference AII-AP-2026, dated January 1, 2026) covers the year ahead.
